notes.title: Sailor Gull Enemy Update
notes.content:
Happy Friday folks!

This past week was dedicated to finishing the Party Fish enemy sprite and adding the Fish-in-a-Barrel and the Sailor Gull enemies to the game!

For the Party Fish I started out with an outline this time
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/ac8e3c2fb93e009eea3a625b6a058d02262b8a68.png[/img]

Then I added the base colors with the water color as background to make sure the fish stood out enough.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/e9d8fab1792397d7c9ea4578b361afc342a6e00b.png[/img]

After that I painted in shadows
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/c26be6d061e157b88dcec89662b45e9d95275d7d.png[/img]

Then colored in the highlights
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/e2d80bc95c530cc19b722e27f9da26223c375a9b.png[/img]

And finally tweaking the finer details
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/f5aeb513ca95215c7975b1462ec06002bae969c1.png[/img]

[b]Fish-in-a-Barrel Enemy [/b]

They will hop from place to place and even roll down slopes to get to Captain Caiman's Birthday Bash!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/0daa334c73548a2661d864826b1e348df14c0a78.gif[/img]

[b]Sailor Gull[/b]

These guys are stuck carrying barrels around when they could be partying. If they hurry then they can make it to the party before its over. Be careful, these fellas are on a mission and will toss barrels at you if  get in the way of their work.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/fe135777aa9233e80bb385b4596660ac58c93bf7.gif[/img]


Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST🌟
See you next week!

notes.title: Version Update 0.2.7
notes.content:
Happy Friday folks!

I've made some bug fixes this week, added more hazards, and updated the FlowerHopper boss!

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]     contact with Jelli no longer freezes the game
[*]     the player no longer moves during the pause menu
[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*]     the hunny bun cost for level 2 has been dropped to 6 from 15
[*]     the FlowerHopper's Rival Form has been added ( more on that below )
[*]     added sounds to menu selections
[/list]


The first hazard I added is for the Sunset Harbor world; the Wooden Smasher!

I started with a basic shape

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/1d45d517384c43f7be4ab8e0a06fd465a0b159f8.png[/img]

Then I outlined it in a dark brown and broke up some detailed shapes like the pole and center nob thingy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3b1c88ebd6f8b2f965d0d90b74b04139c781be2d.png[/img]

Next, I added some basic details like the grain lines of the wood.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/1bde5b9399e5b421a65834c231c572dfc6960df0.png[/img]

Then I added shadows and highlights to the wood and colored the connecting nut yellow to break up the color.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/3b92f6a0887324a7e0c5e24cc382ff19d2036e8c.png[/img]

I finally finished it with a stone base and a wheel that turns when it goes up and down
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/649605cdca723c8fb475d085a4e0162b518b4ade.png[/img]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/02ee0e847cdb1a8246b99d0c63a0de7de0ce7f4c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/02ee0e847cdb1a8246b99d0c63a0de7de0ce7f4c.gif[/img][/url]


The next hazard is a Swinging Ball. It just has basic functionality for now and can be quite challenging to get past.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/fb3534035de4234088071fc4e7c5f326d92111c8.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/fb3534035de4234088071fc4e7c5f326d92111c8.gif[/img][/url]

Every boss has what's called a Rival Form. This form is activated when certain objectives are failed.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/b482214a5cc3f855f65cedb27099ac9a4b0f13a5.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44863355/b482214a5cc3f855f65cedb27099ac9a4b0f13a5.gif[/img][/url]

Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST🌟 
See you next week!

notes.title: Saving Progress!
notes.content:
Happy Thursday folks!


These past two weeks have been filled with fixing bugs and implementing saving and loading your progress!


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]     the pause menu no longer stays on the screen when exited
[*]     movement is paused until the level title loads in
[*]     dialog boxes no longer freeze the player when they disappear
[*]     the world map no longer has movement issues
[/list]


[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]     the mouse is no longer required to rebind keys
[*]     you can now save and load your progress
[/list]

Thanks for reading and be sure to WISHLIST on Steam🌟 See you next week!
Blokhed Jelli
